ns2:section.sectionText: Description: Reviews a broad range of recent theories about media. Primarily focuses on theories of contemporary media and their context, but will devote some attention to recent theories that have rethought earlier media/contexts. Focuses on media theory, but also examines how this theory informs various kinds of analysis. Though the course is offered through the College of Media and the Institute of Communications Research, it is designed for students from any discipline who have an interest in media and/or theory.
